3002.sigma:
title: AWS IAM Role Trust Policy Uses Set-Qualified Operator on GitHub OIDC Sub Claim
id: 8e0e8b9b-7d5f-4f6a-9d2e-3f2c5a1b7e44
description: Detects CreateRole / UpdateAssumeRolePolicy CloudTrail events whose policy document uses set-qualified string operators (ForAnyValue / ForAllValues) on token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub — the misconfiguration class that @hulumi/policies <1.3.2 (GHSA-q2f7-m237-v562) failed to flag.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q2f7-m237-v562
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/avoiding-mistakes-with-aws-oidc-integration-conditions
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1098.003
  - attack.t1199
  - attack.t1078.004
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection_event:
    eventSource: 'iam.amazonaws.com'
    eventName:
      - 'CreateRole'
      - 'UpdateAssumeRolePolicy'
  selection_operator:
    requestParameters.policyDocument|contains:
      - 'ForAnyValue:StringLike'
      - 'ForAnyValue:StringEquals'
      - 'ForAllValues:StringLike'
      - 'ForAllValues:StringEquals'
  selection_oidc:
    requestParameters.policyDocument|contains: 'token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub'
  condition: all of selection_*
level: high
3002.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Changes.command) as policyDocument values(All_Changes.user) as user values(All_Changes.src) as src_ip values(All_Changes.user_agent) as user_agent from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.object_category="role" All_Changes.action IN ("created","modified","updated") All_Changes.vendor_product="AWS CloudTrail" by All_Changes.object
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
| where match(policyDocument, "(?i)(ForAnyValue|ForAllValues):String(Like|Equals)") AND match(policyDocument, "(?i)token\.actions\.githubusercontent\.com:sub")
| eval has_wildcard_sub=if(match(policyDocument, "(?i)token\.actions\.githubusercontent\.com:sub[^,}]*\*"),"yes","no")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime, lastTime, object, user, src_ip, user_agent, has_wildcard_sub, policyDocument
3002.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(CreateRole OR UpdateAssumeRolePolicy) @requestParameters.policyDocument:(*ForAnyValue\:StringLike* OR *ForAnyValue\:StringEquals* OR *ForAllValues\:StringLike* OR *ForAllValues\:StringEquals*) @requestParameters.policyDocument:*token.actions.githubusercontent.com\:sub*

3004.sent:
// Fission runs on Kubernetes (Linux) - this detection lives in ingress/WAF logs forwarded to CommonSecurityLog or web-tier IIS logs in front of the router
union isfuzzy=true
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestURL has "/fission-function/"
  | where DestinationPort == 8888 or isempty(tostring(DestinationPort))
  | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, RequestMethod, RequestURL, EventOutcome, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, RequestClientApplication
  | extend Verdict = case(EventOutcome has "200", "Successful unauthorized invocation", EventOutcome has "502", "Cold-start - function exists", EventOutcome has "404", "Probe miss", "Other - verify")
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csUriStem has "/fission-function/"
  | where sPort == 8888
  | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP=cIP, DestinationIP=Computer, DestinationPort=sPort, RequestMethod=csMethod, RequestURL=strcat(csUriStem, iff(isnotempty(csUriQuery), strcat("?",csUriQuery), "")), EventOutcome=tostring(scStatus), DeviceVendor="Microsoft", DeviceProduct="IIS", RequestClientApplication=csUserAgent
  | extend Verdict = case(EventOutcome == "200", "Successful unauthorized invocation", EventOutcome == "502", "Cold-start - function exists", EventOutcome == "404", "Probe miss", "Other - verify")
)
| where Verdict != "Probe miss"   // 200/502 = signal; 404 alone is enumeration noise covered by UC2
| order by TimeGenerated desc
3004.sigma:
title: Fission Router Unauthorized Function Invocation via /fission-function/ Path (CVE-2026-46614)
id: a7c4e9d2-3b8f-4c2a-91e7-fb7d6a8c1e3f
description: Detects HTTP requests to the /fission-function/<ns>/<name> path on the Fission router public listener (port 8888). On vulnerable versions (<= 1.22.0) this allows direct invocation of any Function without HTTPTrigger restrictions. Post-fix the path moved to internal port 8889 - so any hit on 8888 indicates exploitation or an unpatched cluster.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3g33-6vg6-27m8
  - https://github.com/fission/fission/releases/tag/v1.23.0
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1133
  - cve.2026.46614
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_path:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/fission-function/'
  selection_port:
    dst_port: 8888
  filter_probe_miss:
    sc-status: 404
  condition: selection_path and selection_port and not filter_probe_miss
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate internal trigger sources (kubewatcher / timer / mqtrigger) misconfigured to hit the public listener instead of the new svc/router-internal:8889
  - Penetration tests / vulnerability scans authorized against the cluster
level: high
3004.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/fission-function/*" by _time, Web.src, Web.dest, Web.dest_port, Web.url, Web.http_method, Web.status, Web.http_user_agent
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval dest_port=coalesce(dest_port,"unknown")
| where (dest_port="8888" OR dest_port="unknown") AND status!="404"
| eval reason=case(status=="200","Successful unauthorized invocation",status=="502","Cold-start invocation (function exists)",status=="401","Auth challenge (post-patch)",true(),"Other - verify manually")
| table _time, src, dest, dest_port, http_method, url, status, reason, http_user_agent

3005.sent:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let MinUniquePaths = 5;
let MinProbeMisses = 3;
union isfuzzy=true
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where RequestURL has "/fission-function/"
  | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, RequestURL, Status=tostring(EventOutcome), UserAgent=RequestClientApplication, Router=DestinationIP
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where csUriStem has "/fission-function/"
  | where sPort == 8888
  | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP=cIP, RequestURL=csUriStem, Status=tostring(scStatus), UserAgent=csUserAgent, Router=Computer
)
| summarize
    UniqueFunctionPaths = dcount(RequestURL),
    TotalRequests = count(),
    HitFunctions = dcountif(RequestURL, Status in ("200","502")),
    MissFunctions = dcountif(RequestURL, Status == "404"),
    SamplePaths = make_set(RequestURL, 20),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 5),
    Routers = make_set(Router, 3)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes), SourceIP
| where UniqueFunctionPaths >= MinUniquePaths and MissFunctions >= MinProbeMisses
| extend EnumerationConfidence = case(
    HitFunctions > 0 and MissFunctions >= 3, "High - mixed 200/502 hits with 404 misses (likely successful enumeration)",
    MissFunctions >= 10, "Medium - heavy 404 probing",
    "Low")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
3005.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t dc(Web.url) as UniqueFunctionPaths, count as TotalRequests, dc(eval(if(Web.status=="200" OR Web.status=="502", Web.url, null()))) as HitFunctions, dc(eval(if(Web.status=="404", Web.url, null()))) as MissFunctions, values(Web.http_user_agent) as UserAgents, values(Web.dest) as Routers from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/fission-function/*" by _time span=10m, Web.src
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where UniqueFunctionPaths >= 5 AND MissFunctions >= 3
| eval EnumerationConfidence=case(HitFunctions>0 AND MissFunctions>=3,"High - mixed 200/502 hits with 404 misses",MissFunctions>=10,"Medium - heavy 404 probing",true(),"Low")
| table _time, src, UniqueFunctionPaths, TotalRequests, HitFunctions, MissFunctions, EnumerationConfidence, Routers, UserAgents

title: BadIIS-style Native Module Dropped Into IIS Path by Non-Installer Process
id: a3c0f1c8-8b62-4f1d-9c4e-d70e5c0e1f12
description: Detects file writes of DLL or EXE payloads into IIS-served directories (\inetsrv\, \inetpub\wwwroot\bin\) by a process that is NOT msiexec / TrustedInstaller / appcmd / drvinst. Aligns with Cisco Talos BadIIS commodity variant (May 2026) whose modules drop into IIS module paths and carry 'demo.pdb' strings.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-art-of-being-ungovernable/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.004
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_paths:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetsrv\'
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\bin\'
      - '\inetpub\custerr\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.dll'
      - '.exe'
  filter_trusted_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\appcmd.exe'
      - '\WindowsUpdateBox.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
  condition: selection_paths and not filter_trusted_installers
falsepositives:
  - Custom IIS deployment tooling outside of MSI / appcmd workflow
  - Web-app CI/CD pipelines that drop assemblies into bin\
level: medium

3021.sigma:
title: VS Code/Cursor Extension Host Fetches nrwl/nx Orphan-Commit Dropper
id: c47e8b95-2a13-4f08-b1d6-7c5e9f3a6e72
description: Detects Code.exe, Cursor.exe or their Node extension host contacting GitHub paths under nrwl/nx (raw, codeload, blob/tree APIs) — the dropper path used by the May 2026 Nx Console v18.95.0 compromise.
references:
    - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/vs-code-extension-github-breach
    - https://github.com/nrwl/nx-console/security/advisories/GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w
    - https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/compromised-nx-console-18950-targeted.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
    - attack.t1105
    - attack.t1102.001
    - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
    category: network_connection
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_process:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\Code.exe'
            - '\Cursor.exe'
            - '\node.exe'
            - '\Code - Insiders.exe'
            - '\codium.exe'
    selection_destination:
        DestinationHostname|contains:
            - 'raw.githubusercontent.com'
            - 'codeload.github.com'
            - 'api.github.com'
    condition: selection_process and selection_destination
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate nrwl/nx repo cloning by a developer working on the project (verify by path/repo, not just hostname)
level: medium
3021.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url IN ("*raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx/*","*codeload.github.com/nrwl/nx/*","*api.github.com/repos/nrwl/nx/git/blobs/*","*api.github.com/repos/nrwl/nx/git/trees/*")) AND Web.src_app IN ("code.exe","cursor.exe","node.exe","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)") by host Web.dest Web.url Web.src_app Web.user Web.bytes_in | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | where bytes_in > 100000 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3021.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR linux.auditd) @Image:(*\\Code.exe OR *\\Cursor.exe OR *\\node.exe OR *\\Code-Insiders.exe OR *Code\ Helper* OR *cursor-helper*) (@DestinationHostname:(raw.githubusercontent.com OR codeload.github.com OR api.github.com) OR @url:(*raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx/* OR *codeload.github.com/nrwl/nx/* OR *api.github.com/repos/nrwl/nx/git/blobs* OR *api.github.com/repos/nrwl/nx/git/trees*))
3021.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(raw\.githubusercontent\.com|codeload\.github\.com|api\.github\.com)$/i ContextImageFileName=/(Code|Cursor|node|Code Helper|cursor-helper)\.?(exe)?$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 | ContextImageFileName=/(Code|Cursor|node)\.?(exe)?$/i}, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], include=[RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())

3023.sigma:
title: Nx Console Compromise - Python cat.py Daemon Spawned by Code Helper or Node
id: 9e2b5a14-7c83-4d09-b6e5-2a8f1c4d5e6f
description: Detects the Python backdoor cat.py (or its __DAEMONIZED=1 self-relaunch) launched by a VS Code helper, Cursor helper, node or shell parent. Specific to the May 2026 Nx Console v18.95.0 supply-chain compromise.
references:
    - https://github.com/nrwl/nx-console/security/advisories/GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w
    - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/nx-console-vs-code-extension-compromised
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
    - attack.t1059.006
    - attack.execution
    - attack.persistence
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: macos
detection:
    selection_python:
        Image|endswith:
            - '/python'
            - '/python3'
            - '/python3.9'
            - '/python3.10'
            - '/python3.11'
            - '/python3.12'
    selection_payload:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'cat.py'
            - '/.local/share/kitty/'
            - '/tmp/kitty-'
            - '__DAEMONIZED=1'
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '/Code Helper'
            - '/Code Helper (Plugin)'
            - '/Code Helper (Renderer)'
            - '/cursor-helper'
            - '/Cursor'
            - '/node'
            - '/sh'
            - '/zsh'
            - '/bash'
            - '/python'
            - '/python3'
    condition: selection_python and selection_payload and selection_parent
falsepositives:
    - Researcher reproducing the IOC in a sandbox with an annotated commandline
level: high
3023.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("python","python3","python3.9","python3.10","python3.11","python3.12") AND (Processes.process IN ("*cat.py*","*/.local/share/kitty/*","*/tmp/kitty-*","*__DAEMONIZED=1*") OR Processes.parent_process IN ("*__DAEMONIZED=1*","*cat.py*")) AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)","Code","Cursor","cursor-helper","sh","zsh","bash","python","python3") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3023.datadog: source:(linux.auditd OR windows.sysmon) (@process.name:(python OR python3 OR python3.9 OR python3.10 OR python3.11 OR python3.12) OR @Image:(*/python OR */python3 OR *\\python.exe)) (@process.command_line:(*cat.py* OR */.local/share/kitty/* OR */tmp/kitty-* OR *__DAEMONIZED=1*) OR @CommandLine:(*cat.py* OR *__DAEMONIZED=1*)) (@process.parent.name:(node OR Code\ Helper OR cursor-helper OR Cursor OR sh OR zsh OR bash OR python OR python3) OR @ParentImage:(*\\node.exe OR *Code\ Helper* OR *cursor-helper*))
3023.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/python(3(\.[0-9]+)?)?$/i
| (CommandLine=/cat\.py/i OR CommandLine=/\/\.local\/share\/kitty\//i OR CommandLine=/\/tmp\/kitty-/i OR CommandLine=/__DAEMONIZED=1/i)
| ParentBaseFileName=/(Code Helper|cursor-helper|Cursor|node|bash|zsh|sh|python3?)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

3024.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileAccessed","FileRead","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","node.exe","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)","cursor-helper","Cursor","Code","code.exe","cursor.exe","python","python3")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/.ssh/","/.aws/","/.config/gcloud/","/.kube/","/.docker/","/.gnupg/","/.claude/")
     or FileName in~ ("id_rsa","id_ed25519","id_ecdsa","credentials","known_hosts","authorized_keys",".npmrc","settings.json","config.json")
     or FileName =~ ".env" or FileName startswith ".env." or FolderPath has "/.npmrc")
| where not (FolderPath has "/.claude/" and FileName != "settings.json")    // narrow .claude noise — only the settings.json file matters
| summarize PathCount = dcount(strcat(FolderPath, FileName)),
            Paths = make_set(strcat(FolderPath, FileName), 25),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where PathCount >= 4    // 4 = sweep threshold; one-off .env read is normal dev work, ≥4 distinct cred files in 10 min is harvesting behaviour
| order by FirstSeen desc
3024.sent:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActingProcessName in~ ("node","node.exe","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)","cursor-helper","Cursor","Code","code.exe","cursor.exe","python","python3")
| where (TargetFilePath has_any ("/.ssh/","/.aws/","/.config/gcloud/","/.kube/","/.docker/","/.gnupg/","/.claude/")
     or TargetFileName in~ ("id_rsa","id_ed25519","id_ecdsa","credentials","known_hosts","authorized_keys",".npmrc")
     or TargetFileName =~ ".env" or TargetFileName startswith ".env."
     or (TargetFilePath has "/.claude/" and TargetFileName =~ "settings.json"))
| summarize PathCount = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            Paths = make_set(TargetFilePath, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where PathCount >= 4    // 4 = empirical sweep threshold
| order by FirstSeen desc

3025.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Tracking TamperedChef Clusters via Certificate and Code Reuse
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("calendaromatic-win_x64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("calendaromatic-win_x64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3025.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Tracking TamperedChef Clusters via Certificate and Code Reuse ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("calendaromatic-win_x64.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("calendaromatic-win_x64.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3026.def:
let TamperedChefSigners = dynamic(["CANDY TECH LTD","G.R.CIGAR. LTD","G.R.CIGAR LTD","TAU CENTAURI LTD","AMARYLLIS SIGNAL LTD","METROPOLITAN DESIGN LLC"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in~ (TamperedChefSigners)
   or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in~ (TamperedChefSigners)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"

id: 7b3c9e21-4a8d-49f2-b1e3-2d5c7f8a01b4
description: Detects file write or process execution matching any of the four published SHA256 hashes for the TeamPCP-attributed Nx Console v18.95.0 supply-chain payload (the 2,777-byte injected main.js stub and the 498KB obfuscated dropper fetched from the nrwl/nx orphan commit).

  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/github-breached-vs-code-extension
  - https://github.com/nrwl/nx-console/security/advisories/GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/nx-console-vs-code-extension-compromised
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Hashes|contains:
      - '1a4afce34918bdc74ae3f31edaffffaa0ee074d83618f53edfd88137927340b8'
      - 'b0cefb66b953e5184b6adb3035e9e267335ac5eabfe1848e07834777b9397b74'
      - 'e7347d90653efc565f03733a95e9209d78f9cfa81e31ff2b2dd9d48d75a4b8b1'
      - '43f2b001846c4966073ebffa5be8f15e491a1e7d32bbd805d57406ff540e0dd9'
  selection_alt:

      - 'b0cefb66b953e5184b6adb3035e9e267335ac5eabfe1848e07834777b9397b74'
      - 'e7347d90653efc565f03733a95e9209d78f9cfa81e31ff2b2dd9d48d75a4b8b1'

falsepositives:

3033.sigma:
title: VS Code Child Process Fetching Nx Console v18.95.0 Stealer From nrwl/nx Orphan Commit
id: 9d4e1a82-6c70-4f3b-bd9a-31e2c4f6087d
description: Detects the second-stage payload-fetch chain of the TeamPCP Nx Console supply-chain attack — a process spawned by VS Code (Code.exe / Code - Insiders.exe / Code Helper) running npx, node, cmd, powershell, bash, or sh with a command line that references the orphan commit SHA 558b09d7ad0d1660e2a0fb8a06da81a6f42e06d2 or fetches from raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/github-breached-vs-code-extension
  - https://github.com/nrwl/nx-console/security/advisories/GHSA-c9j4-9m59-847w
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/nx-console-vs-code-extension-compromised
  - https://nx.dev/blog/nx-console-v18-95-0-postmortem
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\Code.exe'
      - '\Code - Insiders.exe'
      - '\Code Helper.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\npx.cmd'
      - '\npx'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
  cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '558b09d7ad0d1660e2a0fb8a06da81a6f42e06d2'
      - 'raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx'
      - 'github.com/nrwl/nx/raw'
      - 'codeload.github.com/nrwl/nx'
  condition: parent and child and cli
falsepositives:
  - Security researcher pivoting on the orphan-commit SHA from a triage host
level: critical
3033.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process) as pcmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Code.exe","Code - Insiders.exe","code","Code Helper","Code Helper (Plugin)") OR match(Processes.parent_process,"(?i)\\\\Code(?:\\s-\\sInsiders)?\\.exe")) (Processes.process_name IN ("npx.cmd","npx","node.exe","node","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash","sh") AND (Processes.process="*558b09d7ad0d1660e2a0fb8a06da81a6f42e06d2*" OR Processes.process="*raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx*" OR Processes.process="*github.com/nrwl/nx/raw*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
3033.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\Code.exe OR *\\Code\ -\ Insiders.exe OR *\\code OR *\\Code\ Helper.exe OR *\\Code\ Helper) @Image:(*\\npx.cmd OR *\\npx OR *\\node.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\bash.exe OR *\\sh.exe) @CommandLine:(*558b09d7ad0d1660e2a0fb8a06da81a6f42e06d2* OR *raw.githubusercontent.com/nrwl/nx* OR *github.com/nrwl/nx/raw* OR *codeload.github.com/nrwl/nx*)
3033.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(code|Code|Code - Insiders|Code Helper|Code Helper \(Plugin\)|Code Helper \(Renderer\))(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(npx(\.cmd)?|node(\.exe)?|cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe|bash|sh)$/i
| regex("558b09d7ad0d1660e2a0fb8a06da81a6f42e06d2|raw\\.githubusercontent\\.com/nrwl/nx|github\\.com/nrwl/nx/raw|codeload\\.github\\.com/nrwl/nx", field=CommandLine)

3035.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Webworm: New burrowing techniques
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("secretsdump.py", "searchapp.exe", "ssh.exe", "svc.exe", "0316.exe", "dsocks.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("secretsdump.py", "searchapp.exe", "ssh.exe", "svc.exe", "0316.exe", "dsocks.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3035.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Webworm: New burrowing techniques ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("secretsdump.py","searchapp.exe","ssh.exe","svc.exe","0316.exe","dsocks.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("secretsdump.py","searchapp.exe","ssh.exe","svc.exe","0316.exe","dsocks.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3036.def:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("discord.com","discordapp.com","discord.gg","cdn.discordapp.com")
   or RemoteUrl has_any ("/api/v9/","/api/v10/")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","Discord.exe","DiscordPTB.exe","DiscordCanary.exe","Spotify.exe","slack.exe","Teams.exe","ms-teams.exe","WebexTeams.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize ConnCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            DistinctRemoteIPs = dcount(RemoteIP)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where ConnCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
3036.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RecentInterpreters = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\rundll32.exe","\\regsvr32.exe","\\mshta.exe","\\curl.exe","\\wget.exe")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project InterpreterTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, NewProcessId;
let DiscordTraffic = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DstHostname has_any ("discord.com","discordapp.com","discord.gg","cdn.discordapp.com")
       or Url has_any ("/api/v9/","/api/v10/","discord.com/api","discordapp.com/api")
    | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr, DstHostname, Url;
DiscordTraffic
| join kind=inner RecentInterpreters on $left.DvcHostname == $right.Computer
| where NetTime between (InterpreterTime .. InterpreterTime + 1h)
| summarize ConnCount=count(), FirstNet=min(NetTime), LastNet=max(NetTime), Interpreters=make_set(NewProcessName), SampleCmd=any(CommandLine), SampleUrl=any(Url)
        by DvcHostname, SubjectUserName, DstHostname
| where ConnCount >= 3
| order by FirstNet desc

3069.def:
// Defender Advanced Hunting has no native web-server log table; this detection lives in IIS / AppService / WAF logs and is expressed on Sentinel side.
// Closest Defender pivot: any process on a zrok-hosting endpoint making an outbound connection to a link-local / loopback metadata IP shortly after receiving inbound traffic on the share.
let MetadataIPs = dynamic(["127.0.0.1","169.254.169.254","169.254.170.2","fd00:ec2::254","100.100.100.200"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("zrok.exe","zrok","python.exe","python3","python","pythonw.exe")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("zrok share","ProxyShare","zrok.proxy","urllib.parse.urljoin")
| where RemoteIP in (MetadataIPs) or RemoteIP startswith "169.254."
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
3069.sent:
// Hunt inbound HTTP requests where the URI itself is an absolute URL (the zrok ProxyShare SSRF shape).
let Lookback = 7d;
let AbsoluteUrlPath = @"(?i)^/+https?:/";
let MetadataMarkers = dynamic(["127.0.0.1","169.254.169.254","metadata.google","metadata.azure","100.100.100.200","/metadata","/latest/meta-data","/computeMetadata"]);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csUriStem matches regex AbsoluteUrlPath
         or csUriQuery has_any (MetadataMarkers)
    | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Computer,
              ClientIP = cIP, Method = csMethod,
              UriStem = csUriStem, UriQuery = csUriQuery,
              Status = scStatus, UserAgent = csUserAgent,
              SourceTable = "W3CIISLog"
),
(
    AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where CsUriStem matches regex AbsoluteUrlPath
         or CsUriQuery has_any (MetadataMarkers)
    | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Computer = CsHost,
              ClientIP = CIp, Method = CsMethod,
              UriStem = CsUriStem, UriQuery = CsUriQuery,
              Status = ScStatus, UserAgent = UserAgent,
              SourceTable = "AppServiceHTTPLogs"
)
| extend AbsoluteUrlInPath = iff(UriStem matches regex AbsoluteUrlPath, true, false)
| extend MetadataTargeted = iff(UriStem has_any (MetadataMarkers) or UriQuery has_any (MetadataMarkers), true, false)
| where AbsoluteUrlInPath or MetadataTargeted
| order by TimeGenerated desc

3072.def:
// HAXcms is a Node.js web app — the JWT/Authorization header signal lives on the web tier (AppServiceHTTPLogs / W3CIISLog), not in DeviceProcessEvents.
// On hosts that run HAXcms AND are enrolled in Defender, this query approximates the post-exploit chain by joining
// outbound DNS lookups from the suspected attacker host to HAXcms domains with subsequent file modifications under
// HAXcms content roots performed by the local node.exe.
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let HaxcmsHostHints = dynamic(["haxcms","haxtheweb"]);
let NetTouch = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (HaxcmsHostHints) or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any ("\\haxcms\\","/haxcms/","\\_sites\\","/_sites/","site.json","manifest.json")
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| join kind=inner NetTouch on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (NetTime .. NetTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, NetTime)
| project NetTime, FileWriteTime = Timestamp, DelaySec, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP,
          FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by NetTime desc

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,

          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,

3137.sigma:
title: utcp-cli Command Injection via UTCP_ARG Placeholder Substitution (CVE-2026-45369)
id: 6f8d4e2a-1c9b-4d3f-9a7e-7b3a5c8f1d44
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects exploitation of CVE-2026-45369 in utcp-cli <= 1.1.1. The library generates
  shell scripts of the form `CMD_<N>_OUTPUT=$(<command> 2>&1)` and executes them via
  /bin/bash -c. Unescaped attacker-controlled tool_args allow shell metacharacters
  (;, $(), `, |) to break out of the intended command. This rule fires on a python
  parent spawning bash where the command line carries both the utcp-cli script
  signature and metacharacters indicative of injection.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-33p6-5jxp-p3x4
  - https://www.utcp.io/protocols/cli
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/14
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2026.45369
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|re: '(?i)(^|/)python(3(\.\d+)?)?$'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/dash'
  selection_utcp_template:
    CommandLine|re: 'CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=\$\('
  selection_injection_marker:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)(;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl|base64|chmod)|`[^`]+`|\$\(\s*(cat|curl|wget|whoami|id|base64|nc)|\|\s*(sh|bash|nc|base64|tee)|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts))'
  condition: all of selection_*
fields:
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate utcp-cli tool definitions whose static templates contain shell metacharacters (rare; the patch in 1.1.2 shell-quotes substitutions so any post-patch host that still matches indicates a downgrade)
level: high
3137.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python","python3","python3.9","python3.10","python3.11","python3.12","python.exe","pythonw.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("bash","sh","dash","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) AND Processes.process="*CMD_*_OUTPUT=$(*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rex field=process "CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=\$\((?<substituted>[^)]+)\)"
| eval injected=if(match(substituted,"(?i)(;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl|powershell|base64|chmod|chown)|`[^`]+`|\$\(\s*(cat|curl|wget|whoami|id|uname|hostname|base64|nc)|\|\s*(sh|bash|nc|base64|tee)|>\s*/(tmp|var|dev|etc)|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|&&\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash))"),1,0)
| where injected=1
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name parent_process process_name process substituted

3138.def:
// Approach A — TVM software inventory (fast, no host scan)
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where SoftwareVendor in~ ("universal-tool-calling-protocol","utcp","pypi")
| where SoftwareName has "utcp" and SoftwareName has "cli"
| extend V = split(SoftwareVersion, ".")
| extend Major = toint(V[0]), Minor = toint(V[1]), Patch = toint(V[2])
| where Major < 1 or (Major == 1 and Minor == 0) or (Major == 1 and Minor == 1 and Patch <= 1)
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| union (
    // Approach B — fallback: pip install / runtime invocation evidence
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"(?i)^(pip3?|python(3(\.\d+)?)?)(\.exe)?$"
        or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^(pip3?|python(3(\.\d+)?)?)(\.exe)?$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("utcp_cli","utcp-cli")
    | summarize Hosts = make_set(DeviceName), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine) by FileName
    | mv-expand DeviceName = Hosts to typeof(string)
    | project DeviceName, OSPlatform="", SoftwareName="utcp-cli (cmdline-evidence)", SoftwareVersion=tostring(SampleCmd)
)
| order by DeviceName asc
3138.sent:
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where CveId == "CVE-2026-45369"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, OSPlatform, OSVersion, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| union (
    DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where SoftwareName has "utcp" and SoftwareName has "cli"
    | extend V = split(SoftwareVersion, ".")
    | extend Major = toint(V[0]), Minor = toint(V[1]), Patch = toint(V[2])
    | where Major < 1 or (Major == 1 and Minor == 0) or (Major == 1 and Minor == 1 and Patch <= 1)
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, OSPlatform, OSVersion, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel="High", RecommendedSecurityUpdate="Upgrade utcp-cli >= 1.1.2"
)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceName, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| order by DeviceName asc
3138.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as sample_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("python","python3","python3.9","python3.10","python3.11","python3.12","python.exe","pip","pip3") AND (Processes.process="*utcp_cli*" OR Processes.process="*utcp-cli*" OR Processes.process="*-m utcp*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rex field=sample_cmd "utcp[-_]cli[=<>]+(?<version>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"
| eval vulnerable=case(isnotnull(version) AND match(version,"^(0\.|1\.0\.|1\.1\.[01])$"),"yes",isnull(version),"unknown_check_pip_freeze",1=1,"no")
| where vulnerable!="no"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`

3170.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Ongoing exploitation of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerabilities
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("miner.sh", "loot_run.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh", "/tmp/moneroocean/config_background.json", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("miner.sh", "loot_run.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3170.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Ongoing exploitation of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerabilities ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("miner.sh","loot_run.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/moneroocean/miner.sh*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/moneroocean/config_background.json*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("miner.sh","loot_run.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

let LookbackHours = 6h;
let MinRequestsPerSource = 50;
let MinDistinctFilterValues = 16;  // hex alphabet width: 0-9,a-f
let MaxDurationSec = 1800;          // burst must be tight (~30 min) to count as oracle
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where Url matches regex @"(?i)where\[(updatedBy|createdBy|publishedBy)\]\[(email|password|resetPasswordToken|confirmationToken|firstname|lastname|preferedLanguage)\]\[\$"
| extend FilterValue = extract(@"(?i)where\[\w+\]\[\w+\]\[\$\w+\]=([0-9a-fA-F]+)", 1, Url)
| extend FilterFieldTuple = extract(@"(?i)(where\[\w+\]\[\w+\]\[\$\w+\])=", 1, Url)
| where isnotempty(FilterValue)
| summarize
    RequestCount   = count(),
    DistinctValues = dcount(FilterValue),
    SampleValues   = make_set(FilterValue, 20),
    DistinctTuples = dcount(FilterFieldTuple),
    SampleTuples   = make_set(FilterFieldTuple, 5),
    UAs            = make_set(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, 5),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName
| extend DurationSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where RequestCount >= MinRequestsPerSource and DistinctValues >= MinDistinctFilterValues and DurationSec <= MaxDurationSec
| order by RequestCount desc

title: Amazon Redshift JDBC Driver Class-Loading RCE Attempt (CVE-2026-8178)
id: 4d2f6a18-1c9e-4d5d-9d4d-8a6e9d5a8b22
description: |
  Detects a Java process invoked with a `jdbc:redshift://` connection URL that
  carries one of the four connection parameters (socketFactory, sslfactory,
  sslhostnameverifier, sslpasswordcallback) which the Amazon Redshift JDBC
  Driver < 2.2.2 instantiates as an arbitrary class — the primitive behind
  CVE-2026-8178 (CWE-470 unsafe class loading).
references:
  - https://github.com/aws/amazon-redshift-jdbc-driver/security/advisories/GHSA-wmmv-vvg5-993q
  - https://aws.amazon.com/security/security-bulletins/rss/2026-028-aws/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/14
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1203
  - cve.2026.8178
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
  selection_jdbc:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'jdbc:redshift'
      - 'jdbc%3Aredshift'
  selection_param:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'socketFactory='
      - 'sslfactory='
      - 'sslhostnameverifier='
      - 'sslpasswordcallback='
  condition: selection_image and selection_jdbc and selection_param
falsepositives:

3241.def:

| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,

| order by Timestamp desc

| order by Timestamp desc

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,

| order by Timestamp desc
